description: A dean of students must finalize the response and student-record entry for a suspected academic-integrity violation, with input from the student's English teacher and the registrar.

shared_context.S1: A tenth-grade student is being reviewed for a possible academic-integrity violation on an English research assignment.
shared_context.S2: The school's academic-integrity handbook provides responses ranging from a warning and assignment revision to an in-school suspension and a formal conduct entry.
shared_context.S3: Ms. Okafor has authority to approve the disciplinary response and the associated student-record entry.
shared_context.S4: The school's case-review routine requires the dean to hear one relevant report from the referring teacher and one from the registrar, then close the review and record the decision immediately after both reports are given.

PF1.text: Mr. Bennett's assignment review found that 38 percent of the submission matches an uncited online source, and the student acknowledged using the source without attribution during a conference. Under the handbook, a confirmed match above 30 percent requires a zero on the assignment, a required redo within 5 school days, and a parent conference; Mr. Bennett completed the review yesterday but has not entered it in the case system.

PF2.text: Ms. Ibarra's conduct audit found one prior substantiated academic-integrity violation from 8 months ago. Under the handbook, a second substantiated violation within 12 months requires 1 school day of in-school suspension and the conduct code AI-2 rather than a warning or informal note; she completed the audit this morning but has not attached it to the case.

acceptance_conditions: The response must impose one school day of in-school suspension.
The assignment must receive a zero.
The student must be required to redo the assignment within 5 school days.
A parent conference must be scheduled.
The conduct entry must use code AI-2.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'parent_conference' for c in commitments) and decisions['assignment_score'] == 0 and decisions['redo_due_within_school_days'] == 5

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed 38-percent match and admission change the assignment outcome to exactly 0, set the redo deadline to exactly 5 school days, and require a parent conference.
The prior violation within 12 months changes the response to in-school suspension, sets suspension_days to exactly 1, and changes the conduct code to exactly AI-2.
